mentions.name: Screensnipe
mentions.description: A lightweight screenshot and screen recording tool built as a personal replacement for Snagit, offering only the features the author needs with no bloat.
mentions.problem: The author's heavily used screenshot tool Snagit had become bloated, got in the way, and its license renewal was too expensive to justify.
mentions.audience: A home-cooked personal tool, built around exactly the features the author needs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I'm building my own replacement.

Yes, it's another screenshot and recording tool. But this one has exactly the features I need, nothing more and nothing less. It's like a home-cooked meal. Sure, it's vibe-coded, but it has a bit of an engineer's touch.
